name: Valletta

categories.label: Points scored during play (street track)
categories.labelVi: Điểm ghi trên đường (trong lúc chơi)
categories.hint: Position of your figure on the street incl. 25/50 and 75/100 tokens

categories.label: Points printed on your buildings
categories.labelVi: Điểm in trên các công trình
categories.hint: Sum the value in the bottom-right corner of each building you own

categories.label: Goods owned (gold, wood, stone, brick)
categories.hint: Total goods of any type; 1 VP per 3 goods, rounded down

categories.label: Houses built (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Not scored; used only to break ties

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who built the most houses wins
If still tied, the tied players share the victory

endCondition.description: Final phase starts when a player moves Valette onto the last barrel, reaches space 25, or places an 8th house; each player then plays out their whole deck once

notes: family: engine-tableau. Rulebook text read via a rules transcription site, not the publisher PDF. Building points are summed per building on the final tally; trackPoints is the street figure position (with tokens above 25) after in-game scoring.

sources.title: Valletta rules (UltraBoardGames transcription)
